## Access conditions (important caveat on evidence grade)
This session's egress proxy allowed WebFetch ONLY to github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com.
The following domains returned `EGRESS_BLOCKED` (HTTP 403 at the gateway) and could NOT be
read directly; everything attributed to them below comes from **search-engine snippets
summarised by the WebSearch tool**, which is a weaker evidence grade than a primary read:

  tibiasecrets.com, tibiaqa.com, web.archive.org, pcgamer.com, en.wikipedia.org,

No circumvention was attempted beyond one Google-translate mirror, which was also blocked.

  O=O, ]=P, Q=Q(k), B=R, ~=S, L=T, C=U, >=V, U=W, +=X(ks), \=Y, /=Z; ° or ! = lowered
